Screen mirroring and Casting is a safe way to share your screen with another device because you connect your device via home network. Therefore, there’s no risk of losing any data. When you use screen mirroring, your data is securely stored on your device. The copy of your screen that is beamed to your TV is immediately deleted once it hits the big screen. Our app does not collect any data whatsoever!
